script.title: Temple of the Nine Rings
script.description: A Japanese Buddhist temple ensemble: five-storey vermilion pagoda, an irimoya-roofed worship hall, open prayer veranda, golden altar, stone lanterns and an autumn maple. Sweeping ceramic eaves and exposed timber brackets finish every side.
